screens.name: Launch
screens.rules: No business decision performed here

screens.name: Welcome
screens.purpose: Explain Mingo promise and let learner start
screens.rules: No efficacy/mastery claim

screens.name: Goal
screens.rules: Goal cannot rewrite measured skill

screens.name: Placement Offer
screens.rules: Placement optional; missing evidence allowed

screens.name: Placement Question
screens.states: Ready, selected, validation-error, submitting, result, skipped-domain, audio-unavailable
screens.rules: Placement response requires explicit selection/allowed domain skip; provisional only; listening play request is not score authority.

screens.name: Placement Result
screens.purpose: Show provisional starting state and uncertainty
screens.rules: Qualitative/provisional language only

screens.name: Home
screens.purpose: Answer what to do next and why
screens.rules: Reason copy must match logged reason; no risk/mastery percentage

screens.name: Home Offline
screens.purpose: Home with offline status and device-saved distinction
screens.rules: Queued is not server-confirmed

screens.name: Home Syncing
screens.purpose: Show background synchronization without blocking navigation
screens.rules: No duplicate progress/reward from retries

screens.name: Learn Hub
screens.purpose: Start or resume finite learning cycle
screens.rules: No infinite feed

screens.name: Cycle Intro
screens.purpose: Show objective, reason and approximate duration
screens.rules: ~5 min is configurable hypothesis; objective/reason explicit

screens.name: Review Item
screens.rules: Blank submit is impossible; Skip is explicit and creates no completion/mastery.

screens.name: Learn Content
screens.rules: Reading explanation alone is not mastery

screens.name: Retrieve Item
screens.states: Ready, selected, hinted, submitted-result, retry-available, retry-exhausted, skipped
screens.rules: First response is preserved; assisted flag persists independently of feedback; one retry is the current configurable policy.

screens.name: Transfer Item
screens.rules: Blank submit is impossible; transfer is within objective and does not change level.

screens.name: Check Intro
screens.rules: No pre-submit hint in Check

screens.name: Check Item
screens.states: Ready, selected, validation-error, submitting, result, audio-ready, audio-unavailable, play-limit-reached
screens.rules: No pre-submit hint; blank submit impossible; Check has no practice retry; listening play requests are client telemetry only.

screens.name: Correct Feedback
screens.rules: Reward/copy cannot imply validated mastery from one answer

screens.name: Incorrect / Retry Feedback
screens.purpose: Explain error and offer practice retry where policy allows
screens.states: Retry available, retry used, retry exhausted
screens.rules: Retry correct never overwrites first wrong

screens.name: Hint Panel
screens.rules: Hint use marks evidence assisted

screens.name: Skip Confirmation
screens.purpose: Confirm skip without shame or false completion
screens.rules: Skip != completion/mastery/streak

screens.name: Cycle Summary
screens.purpose: Explicit closure, practiced evidence and next step
screens.rules: No fake mastery %; user explicitly starts another cycle

screens.name: Resume Cycle
screens.rules: No duplicate submit on resume

screens.name: Course Map
screens.rules: Preview does not unlock/progress

screens.name: Objective Detail
screens.rules: Prerequisite guardrail remains authoritative

screens.name: Locked Preview
screens.rules: Preview cannot create evidence, progress, completion, prerequisite bypass or unlock.

screens.name: Profile
screens.purpose: Goal, qualitative learning evidence and settings entry
screens.rules: Engagement/streak not presented as mastery

screens.name: Evidence Detail
screens.purpose: Show observations, uncertainty and missing evidence
screens.rules: No diagnosis or precise mastery percentage without validated model

screens.name: Goal Settings
screens.rules: Goal change does not rewrite competence

screens.name: Learning Preferences
screens.rules: Preference cannot bypass required eligibility rules

screens.name: Offline Downloads
screens.rules: Access grant/package rules remain server-authoritative

screens.name: Sync Queue
screens.purpose: Explain queued/synced items without technical jargon
screens.rules: Connectivity and server acknowledgement are distinct; Synced appears only after authoritative acknowledgement/canonical refresh.

screens.name: Sync Error
screens.rules: Recovery reuses durable command identity; local state never overwrites server truth.

screens.name: Generic Error
screens.rules: No false success state

screens.name: Nothing Due / Content Gap
screens.rules: Do not fabricate cycle/recommendation

screens.name: Re-auth Required
screens.rules: Phase 3 implements auth; no local permission bypass

screens.name: Staff Entry
screens.rules: Actual authentication/authorization belongs Phase 3

screens.name: Dashboard
screens.rules: Metrics must identify time range/source

screens.name: Learner List
screens.rules: Role visibility is not authorization

screens.name: Learner Overview
screens.rules: No mental-state diagnosis; raw risk not default to content admin

screens.name: Learner Evidence
screens.rules: Mastery != risk; uncertainty visible

screens.name: Learner Activity
screens.rules: Historical revision pinning preserved

screens.name: Content Library
screens.rules: Published revision immutable

screens.name: Content Draft Editor
screens.purpose: Author draft content and learning metadata
screens.states: clean, dirty, saving, saved, validation-error, reviewer-changes
screens.rules: Fields have programmatic labels; preview/save/review transitions are explicit; published bytes are never edited.

screens.name: Content Preview
screens.rules: Preview has no publish/progress side effect.

screens.name: Source & License
screens.rules: Publication stays blocked until provenance/license requirement passes.

screens.name: Review Queue
screens.rules: Reviewer actions require later server permission

screens.name: Review Detail
screens.rules: Approve is disabled until provenance/license gate passes.

screens.name: Publish Confirmation
screens.purpose: Confirm creation of immutable published revision
screens.rules: Publish requires explicit confirmation and creates an immutable revision.

screens.name: Published Revision
screens.rules: Published revision is read-only; edits create a new draft/revision.

screens.name: Interventions
screens.rules: Phase 11/12 domain behavior not implemented in Phase 2

screens.name: Intervention Detail
screens.rules: Recommendation lifecycle layers remain distinct

screens.name: Analytics Overview
screens.rules: Event time/known time/source context required

screens.name: Metric Detail
screens.purpose: Inspect metric definition, cohort and time window
screens.rules: No hidden denominator or future-data leakage

screens.name: Administration
screens.rules: Phase 3/13 define authorization/security

screens.name: Roles & Permissions
screens.rules: UI visibility never substitutes backend authz

screens.name: Audit Log
screens.rules: Privileged actions audited

components.rule: Navigation shell never performs business authorization.
One dominant action per view where possible; disabled reason exposed when important.

components.states: idle, selected, focus, disabled, correct, incorrect
components.rule: Color is never the only correctness signal; selection is not submission.
Check mode can remove hint action without changing visual identity beyond clear context label.

components.states: correct-independent, correct-assisted, incorrect, retry-available, retry-exhausted, skipped, final
components.rule: First response, assistance and retry count are independent persistent evidence context; retry never rewrites first response.
Only in practice contexts; using it marks assisted evidence.
Show finite scope; never mimic infinite feed.

components.states: due-review, current-objective, prerequisite-gap, recent-error, transfer, challenge, unavailable
components.rule: Reason must match auditable reason code; no inferred mental-state copy.

components.states: offline, local-queued, syncing, synced, partial, failed-retryable, reauth, canonical-refresh
components.rule: Network connectivity is not server acknowledgement; Synced requires authoritative acknowledgement/canonical refresh.
No fake mastery percentage or diagnosis.
Client playback request count is telemetry only; Check offered-play policy is UI context, never canonical scoring authority.
Recovery action must not create duplicate business command.

components.states: draft, in-review, approved, published, retired, revoked
components.rule: Published is immutable; edit action creates new draft/revision.

components.states: clean, dirty, saving, saved, validation-error, reviewer-changes, license-blocked
components.rule: Field-level labels/validation and provenance/license gate are explicit before publish; published revision is immutable.
Keyboard accessible; row action permission checked server-side later.
Modal uses focus containment and restores focus to invoking control; irreversible publish requires confirmation.

prd_traceability.requirement: Finite objective-based cycle with clear closure
First response preserved; guided retry in practice
Typed hints; assisted != unaided; no pre-submit hint in Check
Listening replay support and assessment context
Learner focus with bounded due/prerequisite insertion
Course map, locked preview, evidence-backed reason
Licensed immutable content and revision pinning
Usable deterministic fallback with ML/recommendation disabled
